title: Provenance + license-text snapshot capture tool
context: Tooling that captures a provenance record and an immutable license-text snapshot (committed copy + SHA-256 + Wayback URL) for each documented dataset. Binding cancer guardrails apply: open-access / aggregate / de-identified data only; controlled-access (dbGaP, EGA, ICGC DACO, individual-level biobanks) and any identifiable patient data are OUT OF SCOPE; COSMIC/OncoKB are non-commercial/custom (flag, never treat as open); no medical advice; provenance on every assertion. Code is MIT-licensed and must be green in CI.
objective: Build the provenance + license-text snapshot capture tool that records repository, accession, retrieval date, release/freeze, required citation, GDS note, and a verifiable license snapshot.
acceptanceCriteria: Captures a provenance record: repository, accession, retrieval date, release/freeze, attribution, required dataset citation, and GDS-policy note.
Produces a license snapshot = committed copy of the license text + its SHA-256 + a Wayback (archive) URL.
Committed golden fixtures exercise the tool in CI; no real inspected data is committed.
Code MIT-licensed; pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm lint green; DCO signed-off; no credentials or secrets.
